stories.title: Wyndham Championship — Michael Brennan Wins at 22-Under
stories.angle: Michael Brennan won the 2026 Wyndham Championship at Sedgefield Country Club in Greensboro, NC, finishing at 22-under 258. He claimed the $1.53M winner's check and 500 FedExCup points, securing his spot in the FedExCup Playoffs. His victory bumped Steven Fisk out of the top 70, eliminating Fisk from playoff contention. Brennan entered the week ranked 105th in FedExCup points; he needed a high finish to survive and he won outright instead.

stories.title: FedExCup Playoffs — St. Jude Championship Starts Thursday
stories.angle: The FedEx St. Jude Championship begins Thursday, August 13, at TPC Southwind in Memphis. The 70-player field is now locked. Scottie Scheffler enters as the No. 1 seed at 4,123 FedExCup points. Rory McIlroy is chasing a historic fourth FedExCup title (which would extend the all-time record he already holds). Tommy Fleetwood is the defending FedExCup champion. The $20M purse carries 750 FedExCup points; the top 50 advance to the BMW Championship.

stories.title: LIV Golf New York — Niemann Wins, Rahm Clinches Season Title
stories.angle: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf New York at Trump National Golf Club in Bedminster, NJ, finishing at 16-under 268 (3 shots ahead of Harold Varner III). It was Niemann's 9th career LIV title and came with a $4M payout. Jon Rahm clinched his third consecutive LIV individual season title with a T41 finish — the standings locked in his favor with no one able to close the gap. Torque GC, Niemann's team, won the team title.

stories.title: Scottie Scheffler — Winless in 2026, FedExCup Reset Awaits
stories.angle: Scottie Scheffler has not won since The American Express in January 2026 (his 20th career title). Five runner-up finishes — Masters, RBC Heritage, Cadillac Championship, Travelers Championship, 3M Open — define his season. He enters the FedExCup Playoffs as the No. 1 seed with 4,123 points. His 35-consecutive top-25 streak snapped at the Genesis Scottish Open. The playoffs represent the best chance to flip the narrative from "best player who isn't winning" to champion.

stories.title: LIV Golf — BC Partners Investment Deal Confirmed, Players Become Majority Owners
stories.angle: LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil confirmed during the Bedminster event that the league has secured a new lead investor: BC Partners' credit arm, providing approximately $250-300M. The deal has been signed by the investor and approved by the board. Under the restructured LIV 2.0 model, players will become majority equity holders, tournament purses will decrease, and 10 events are planned for 2027. The deal is expected to close in September 2026. Saudi Arabia's PIF exits at year-end after investing ~$5 billion since 2022.
